objective: Prove the mirror lemma by hand and have it refereed by fresh code; the frozen exact census of full adders without a reference and of counts mod 3 and mod 4 with one reference point.
status: Proved 2026-11-11: the mirror lemma (a knot space with the not-all-equal law reads a count of n held points mod m only for even m and odd n), by hand, refereed by fresh code; exact census of 1,128 spaces: the 8-point parity torus (2,0,4) is a full adder (13 spaces hold one); no count mod 3 or mod 4 with one held reference point. After the run: of the four kinds of self-dual map using all four of four held points, the spaces show only the two that cannot count mod 3.
title: The mirror lemma, refereed, and the census of counts
